en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a rustic wooden pavilion with a small tower and balcony, set on the edge of a dense coniferous forest. The structure has rough-hewn timber columns and railings in a decorative pattern, with a steep roof on the tower. At the top of the postcard, printed in red Gothic-style script, is the German text indicating the spa town and viewpoint name.
